title: “A Prophet Like Moses”(Deuteronomy 18:15–18)in the Book of Mormon, the Bible, and the Dead Sea Scrolls
author: David R. Seely
abstract: Abstract: David Seely provides a wide-ranging survey of interpretations of the prophecy in Deuteronomy 18:15–18 concerning “a prophet like unto Moses.” He examines relevant passages in the Book of Mormon, the Bible, and the Dead Sea Scrolls and shows how the prophecy has been fulfilled by Jesus Christ and others, continuing with Joseph Smith’s role in the Restoration and onward to the present day.
